linkedin.post:
Two AI deals, one week.

On Friday in Beijing, Anthony Albanese and Premier Li Qiang agreed to establish an AI dialogue "to exchange respective views on AI safety, governance and application", their joint statement says.

Days earlier, Australia joined 9 other countries in signing the US-led San Francisco Declaration to secure AI supply chains.

Albanese says Australia will "cooperate where we can" and "disagree where we must". China controls more than 90% of refining for several critical minerals (ABC).

Is Australia smart to talk AI with both Washington and Beijing, or trying to have it both ways?

Tell us what you think below.

#AusSight #auspol #AI
